name: Bombay Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified). 2025-2026: exchange_publications (manually transcribed from bseindia.com; no fetcher). 2027-2029: predicted from the standing holiday pattern; the exchange publishes each year's list in December and had not published 2027 on 2026-11-21 (4d.1). The 8 disputed days in contradicted_by are exchange_calendars-sourced and contradicted by pandas_market_calendars. The BSE notices for those days are the primary source; the sampling (Phase 4d) resolves them. Rechecked 2026-11-19 (4c-R2). Fixed: regular_hours history. NSE and BSE jointly moved the market open from 09:55 to 09:00 effective 2010-01-04 (BSE/NSE announcement of 2009-12-17), and from 2010-10-18 the 09:00-09:15 pre-open call auction (SEBI circulars of 2010) moved the normal-market open to 09:15; close 15:30 throughout. exchange_calendars has 09:15-15:30 for every year. Checked, no change: the 2026 entries match the 16 published weekday trading holidays, including the 2026-01-15 Maharashtra municipal election closure declared by a separate circular; one-off closures in 2010-2024 (e.g. 2014-04-24, 2014-10-15, 2019-04-29, 2019-10-21, 2024-01-22, 2024-05-20, 2024-11-20) are present; no COVID-19 closure. Not modelled: the one-hour Muhurat trading session on Diwali Laxmi Pujan, a trading holiday with a special evening session whose time is set each year; the schema cannot give a special_session a time, so those days stay closed. No fetcher exists for this exchange; 2025-2026 is a manual transcription from bseindia.com; 2027-2029 are predictions. XNSE and XBOM have identical closures for 2010-2029.
